walk_lead: Follow one couple from their result to an informed decision, in about 5 minutes. Every person here is synthetic.
walk_1: Sign in as Layla. The screening programme found that she and Yousef carry a change in the same gene. If another person is signed in, choose to use a different demo persona first.
walk_2: On My result, read "What this means": the chance for each pregnancy, a two-question check of understanding, and the options, all shown with the same weight.
walk_3: Book Counsellor A. Pick a time, then read exactly what will be shared before you agree.
walk_4: Open the counsellor console, signed in as Counsellor A (c-001). Open Layla's case: it shows only what she agreed to share, an AI draft marked as a draft, and the options to offer neutrally.
walk_5: Edit the note, tick "I have reviewed this note" and press "Sign off and send". Nothing reaches Layla before this.
walk_6: Back on the phone, Help shows the signed note, and the next steps move on.
walk_7: The decision stays with the couple. AMANA never asks for it and never records it.
walk_pair_title: The private check between two phones
walk_pair: Open the wallet in two browsers, or in a normal and a private window. Sign in as Mariam in one and Khalid in the other, then use Check together on both. Each phone learns only whether they share a change in the same gene.
walk_note: This page is for reviewers of the prototype. A real deployment would not have it.
